# Generated banner art

`banner-art-{dark,light}.jpg` (1376x768) were generated with Google Antigravity (`agy` 1.4.12, image-generator subagent) on 04/11/2026 from a text-only prompt: wide, text-free dotted flight paths and faint rounded squares, mint accent, no gradient. The prompt carried only the public brand direction. Checked by hand: no text or logo, no multicolour gradient. The images are blended over the token surface in `render.mjs`, so their own background tint does not show.
